name: selection-hv
description: U7 materialized: the corpus-trained selection order, as a 2-parameter family. The shipped order sorts by isotropic frequency; aniso adds the CSF oblique-effect penalty on diagonals; sel_hv adds a horizontal/vertical asymmetry (positive pushes horizontal frequencies down the order). coeff-stats put the headroom of a fully trained fixed order at +2.2 energy points over the l2-ball, so this asks how much of that a smooth 2-parameter family captures.
unpinnedLabels: Retired in place by EXPERIMENTS.md 7.4: every `aniso = 0` cell in it is really `aniso = 1.2` and its `hv = 0` column really `hv = 0.15`, so twelve non-layout arms resolve to six distinct points. `selection-weights` is the corrected replacement and sets both parameters in all 29 arms. Not fixed here because fixing it means replacing it, and it already has been.
